# Happy Pack Adventures LLC � Full Practice & Service Specification

## Business Identity & Management
- Business Name: Happy Pack Adventures LLC
- Founder & Master Handler: Melissa Floyd
- Phone: (205) 555-PAWS | (205) 555-7297
- Email: melissa@happypackadventures.com
- Location: Birmingham, Alabama
- Service Areas: Birmingham, Hoover, Pelham, Mountain Brook, Vestavia Hills, Homewood, Alabaster, and Central Alabama wedding venues.
- Credentials: Pet First Aid & CPR Certified, Fully Insured and Bonded.

## Service Scopes
1. Photo Companion (Up to 3 Hours):
   - Dedicated chaperone for first look and couple portraits
   - Pre-ceremony decompression walk, hydration, and potty break
   - Attire dressing (bowtie, floral collar, or tuxedo)
   - Professional photo staging with squeakers and reward treats
   - Roundtrip climate-controlled transit with crash-tested safety harness

2. Ceremony Companion (Up to 5 Hours) [Most Requested]:
   - All inclusions from Photo Companion
   - Aisle escorting (ring bearer, flower dog, or bridal party accompaniment)
   - Gentle handling and quiet cues during ceremony vows
   - Post-ceremony guest greeting supervision & family portraits
   - Synchronization with wedding planner and lead photographer
   - Safe transit home, evening dinner feeding, and bedtime tuck-in

3. Extended Wedding Care (Up to 8 Hours):
   - All inclusions from Ceremony Companion
   - Morning bridal suite "getting ready" attendance
   - Cocktail hour guest greeting
   - In-home evening pet sitting & bedtime care
   - Puparazzi Behind-the-Scenes video clips included

## Booking & Reservation Process
- Qualification inquiry: Couples share wedding date, venue, and dog profile.
- Tailored Proposal: Owner Melissa Floyd reviews calendar and issues an itemized proposal with clear terms.
- Commitment Rule: Date is locked once the agreement is signed and the booking deposit ($150) is received.
